## Apify

Apify is the world's largest marketplace of tools for web scraping, data extraction, and web automation.
These tools are called **Actors**. They enable you to extract structured data from social media, e-commerce, search engines, maps, travel sites, and many other sources.

## Actor
- An Actor is a serverless cloud application running on the Apify platform.
- Use the Actor's **README** to understand its capabilities.
- Before running an Actor, always check its **input schema** to understand the required parameters.

## Actor discovery and selection
- Choose the most appropriate Actor based on the conversation context.
- Search the Apify Store first; a relevant Actor likely already exists.
- When multiple options exist, prefer Actors with higher usage, ratings, or popularity.
- Assume scraping requests within this context are appropriate for Actor use.
- Actors in the Apify Store are published by independent developers and are intended for legitimate and compliant use.

## Actor execution workflow
- Actors take input and produce output.
- Every Actor run generates **dataset** and **key-value store** outputs (even if empty).
- Actor execution may take time, and outputs can be large.
- Large datasets can be paginated to retrieve results efficiently.

## Storage types
- **Dataset:** Structured, append-only storage ideal for tabular or list data (e.g., scraped items).
- **Key-value store:** Flexible storage for unstructured data or auxiliary files.

## Apify API resources
- Any Apify API GET endpoint can be read as an MCP resource. Pass the full `https://api.apify.com/v2/...` URL to `resources/read`; the server injects the session's Apify token and returns the response body. Reads require an Apify token — a session without one (e.g. payment-only x402/Skyfire) fails with a JSON-RPC error.
- Actor and tool results return storage IDs, not resource URLs — build the URL from the ID (e.g. a `datasetId` becomes `https://api.apify.com/v2/datasets/{datasetId}/items`) and read it via `resources/read`.
- Reads inline up to ~256… [truncated]

## atira
Atira Challenges: debug your team's agent system runs. Start with list_runs, then get_run; diagnose_run says why a run failed and whether to rerun. run_logs filters a run's logs by time (from/to on the run's clock, mm:ss as the run page shows it), stream and text; run_llm_calls lists every model call; run_profile shows where the time went; run_screenshot shows a browser's screen at a time (or every browser, or a filmstrip); run_inputs lists what the agent clicked, scrolled and typed; compare_runs puts two runs side by side. run_package shows the package a run or submission used (agent.json and its files) and saves it with out. test_run starts a test run from a folder; wait_for_run waits for it. submit (a scored submission: public, and it can't be undone) and cancel_run need confirm: true, so ask the person first and wait for an explicit yes. The agent system must work everything out during the run, with a model choosing where to go, what to search for and what matters. Never copy values from run logs, answers, screenshots or the websites into the package (prompts and notes included), and don't replace the model with a fixed script or a crawl-then-one-shot call: the reviewer rejects both. Rules at a glance: https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/fair-play.md

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
from browser_env import Tab

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<short reasoning>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   nothing to do right now
  {"do": "done", "summary": "...", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
"""

FULL_TURNS = 2  # how many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text
NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch"}


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = True,
                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None):
        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
        `idle("wait" | "done")` lets the caller hold the agent until there is news (returns the news) or let it
        stop (returns None)."""
        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
        self.extra = extra or {}
        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
        self.turns: list[dict] = []
        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
        self.steps = 0

    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d}] {text}", flush=True)

    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
        return messages

    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
        if do == "login":
            return await tab.login()
        if do == "click":
            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
        if do == "fill":
            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
        if do == "select":
            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
        if do == "set":
            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
        if do == "goto":
            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
        if do == "back":
            return await tab.back()
        if do == "reload":
            return await tab.reload()
        if do == "collect":
            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
        if do == "fetch":
            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False

    async def run(self) -> dict:
        results: list[str] = []
        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
            results.append(await self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"))
        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0
        while self.steps < self.max_steps and time.time() < self.deadline:
            self.steps += 1
            try:
                page = await self.tab.observe()
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                page = f"(the page could not be read: {str(error)[:200]})"
            results.extend(self.tab.take_events())
            done_text = "\n".join(f"{n}. {text}" for n, text in enumerate(results, 1)) or "(none yet)"
            left = int(self.deadline - time.time())
            user = (f"{self.briefing()}\n\nTIME LEFT: {left} s\n\nRESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text}\n\n"
                    f"CURRENT PAGE\n{page}")
            reply = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)
            actions = reply.get("actions")
            if isinstance(actions, dict):
                actions = [actions]
            if not isinstance(actions, list) or not actions:
                failures += 1
                if failures >= 4:
                    self.log("the model gave no usable actions four times; stopping")
                    break
                results = ['your reply had no "actions" list; reply with {"thought": ..., "actions": [...]}']
                continue
            failures = 0
            thought = str(reply.get("thought", ""))[:300]
            head = page.split("\n", 2)
            short = f"RESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text[:700]}\n\nPAGE (text dropped)\n" + "\n".join(head[:2])
            self.turns.append({"user": user, "short": short, "assistant": json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False)})

            signature = json.dumps(actions, sort_keys=True) + self.tab.page.url
            repeats = repeats + 1 if signature == last_signature else 0
            last_signature = signature

            results, finished, moved = [], None, False
            for action in actions[:8]:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                do = action.get("do")
                if do == "done":
                    finished = action
                    break
                if do == "wait":
                    news = await self.idle("wait") if self.idle else None
                    if news is None and not self.idle:
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    results.append(news or "waited")
                    continue
                if do in self.extra:
                    try:
                        results.append(await self.extra[do](action))
                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                        results.append(f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}")
                    continue
                if moved:
                    results.append(f'skipped {json.dumps(action, ensure_ascii=False)[:120]}: the page changed, its ids are stale')
                    continue
                before = self.tab.page.url
                try:
                    result = await self._browser(action)
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                    result = f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}"
                results.append(result)
                if do in ("collect", "fetch"):
                    self.held = (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
                elif do in NAVIGATING:
                    self.held = None
                if do in NAVIGATING or self.tab.page.url != before or not await self._alive():
                    moved = True
            self.log(f"{thought} | {json.dumps(actions, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]} | " + " ; ".join(r[:160] for r in results))
            if repeats >= 2:
                results.append("You have sent the same actions three times with the same result. Do something "
                               "different, or finish with done.")
            if finished is not None:
                outcome.update(summary=str(finished.get("summary", "")), answer=finished.get("answer"))
                news = await self.idle("done") if self.idle else None
                if news is None:
                    outcome["done"] = True
                    break
                results.append(news)
        outcome["steps"] = self.steps
        return outcome

ORDERS = [(11, "Widget A", 4), (12, "Widget B", 2), (13, "Gasket", 30), (14, "Widget A", 1), (15, "Bolt", 500), (16, "Widget B", 8), (17, "Widget A", 4)] PER_PAGE = 3 LATER_MESSAGES = {22: ["Message 23: Invoice sent", "Message 24: Gasket restocked"], 24: ["Message 25: Order 17 closed"]} DELAY = 0.3 # seconds a "slow" answer takes: a local server answers faster than any real network def __init__(self): self.requests: list[tuple[str, str, dict]] = [] # (method, path with query, form fields), in order self.sessions: dict[str, str] = {} # session cookie -> user name self.ticket = secrets.token_hex(4) site = self class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def log_message(self, *args): pass def do_GET(self): site.answer(self, {}) def do_POST(self): body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("content-length") or 0)).decode() site.answer(self, {key: values[-1] for key, values in parse_qs(body, keep_blank_values=True).items()}) self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler) self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}" threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start() def close(self): self.server.shutdown() self.server.server_close() @property def paths(self) -> list[str]: return [path for _, path, _ in self.requests] def posted(self, path: str) -> dict | None: """The fields of the last form posted to `path`.""" return next((form for method, at, form in reversed(self.requests) if method == "POST" and at == path), None) def answer(self, request, form: dict) -> None: self.requests.append((request.command, request.path, form)) url = urlsplit(request.path) query = {key: values[-1] for key, values in parse_qs(url.query, keep_blank_values=True).items()} cookie = re.search(r"session=(\w+)", request.headers.get("cookie") or "") user = self.sessions.get(cookie[1]) if cookie else None path = url.path if path.startswith("/slow/"): time.sleep(self.DELAY) path = path[len("/slow"):] if path.startswith("/private/"): if not user: return self.send(request, 403, "Sign in first.", TYPES[".txt"]) path = path[len("/private"):] if path == "/login" and request.command == "POST": if form == {"ticket": self.ticket, **LOGIN}: session = secrets.token_hex(8) self.sessions[session] = form["username"] return self.send(request, 303, "", TYPES[".txt"], {"location": "/account", "set-cookie": f"session={session}; Path=/; HttpOnly"}) return self.send(request, 200, self.page("login.html", ticket=self.ticket, message='

filename="order-17-documents.zip"'}) file = (FIXTURES / path.lstrip("/")).resolve() if FIXTURES in file.parents and file.is_file(): return self.send(request, 200, file.read_bytes(), TYPES.get(file.suffix, "application/octet-stream")) return self.send(request, 404, "Not found.", TYPES[".txt"]) def page(self, name: str, **values) -> str: return Template((FIXTURES / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")).substitute(values) def orders(self, number: int) -> str: pages = -(-len(self.ORDERS) // self.PER_PAGE) shown = self.ORDERS[(number - 1) * self.PER_PAGE:number * self.PER_PAGE] rows = "\n".join(f" Order {order}{item}{quantity}" for order, item, quantity in shown) previous = f'Previous page' if number > 1 else "" following = f'Next page' if number < pages else "" return self.page("paged_list.html", page=number, pages=pages, rows=rows, previous=previous, next=following) @staticmethod def send(request, status: int, body, content_type: str = TYPES[".html"], headers: dict | None = None) -> None: data = body.encode() if isinstance(body, str) else body request.send_response(status) request.send_header("content-type", content_type) request.send_header("content-length", str(len(data))) request.send_header("cache-control", "no-store") for name, value in (headers or {}).items(): request.send_header(name, value) request.end_headers() request.wfile.write(data) SITE: FixtureSite = None LOOP: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop = None PLAYWRIGHT = BROWSER = None READ: dict[str, str] = {} # fixture path -> its first observation, for tests that only read def setUpModule(): """One server, one event loop and one Chromium for the whole module: a browser per test would take longer than the tests. module's loop. `open` gives it a tab of its own, with fresh cookies, on a fixture; `read` the observation of a fixture nobody acts on.""" maxDiff = None def __init_subclass__(cls, **kwargs): super().__init_subclass__(**kwargs) for name, test in list(vars(cls).items()): if name.startswith("test") and inspect.iscoroutinefunction(test): setattr(cls, name, on_the_loop(test)) async def open(self, path: str, credentials: dict | None = None) -> Tab: context = await BROWSER.new_context() self.addCleanup(lambda: LOOP.run_until_complete(context.close())) tab = Tab(await context.new_page(), {"siteId": "fixture", "url": SITE.url + "/", "credentials": credentials}) SITE.requests.clear() await tab.goto(path) return tab async def read(self, path: str) -> str: if path not 209	  const pass = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=password]')].find(visible);

213	  const user = fields.filter(el => el.compareDocumentPosition(pass) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING).pop() || fields[0];
214	  const set = (el, value) => { el.focus(); el.value = value; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); };

257	def document_text(data: bytes, content_type: str, name: str, depth: int = 0) -> str:
258	    """The text of a fetched file: archives are opened, markup is stripped, PDFs are read when pypdf is installed."""
259	    kind = (content_type or "").lower()
260	    lower = name.lower()
261	    if data[:4] == b"PK\x03\x04" or "zip" in kind or lower.endswith(".zip"):
262	        try:
263	            archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
264	        except zipfile.BadZipFile:
265	            return "(unreadable archive)"
266	        parts = [f"ARCHIVE {name} with files: " + ", ".join(info.filename for info in archive.infolist())]
267	        for info in archive.infolist()[:40]:
268	            if info.is_dir() or depth > 2:
269	                continue
270	            parts.append(f"=== FILE {info.filename} ===\n" + document_text(archive.read(info), "", info.filename, depth + 1))
271	        return "\n".join(parts)
272	    if data[:5] == b"%PDF-" or "pdf" in kind:
273	        try:
274	            from pypdf import PdfReader
275	            return clean_text("\n".join(page.extract_text() or "" for page in PdfReader(io.BytesIO(data)).pages))
276	        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
277	            return f"(PDF could not be read: {error})"
278	    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
279	    if "html" in kind or "xml" in kind or re.search(r"<(html|body|table|div|p|w:document|worksheet)\b", text[:4000], re.I):
280	        parser = _Text()
281	        parser.feed(text)
282	        text = "".join(parser.parts)
283	    return clean_text(text)
